subject: 1. Align logo & section grid to one master container
description: Align top-left logo area with the main page content container and keep a consistent left margin across all sections. Today the nav uses max-w-[1180px], about uses 1180px, phone-showcase uses 1100px, business-panel uses 1100px — pick one master width and align padding/grid origin across MarketingNav, Hero, AboutEditorial, PhoneShowcase, BusinessPanel.
